title: no offhand updated
description: An updated and polished version of Battt's datapack to remove the offhand.
body:
Updated version of Battt's No Offhand Datapack

Changes:
* Updated to version 1.21.4
* Removed bug where items are deleted rather than being returned to inventory after being placed in the offhand
* Removed a visual bug when placing items into offhand while having a GUI open
* Placing items into the offhand while having a full inventory will now drop them to be picked up rather than deleting them
